info.title: memory-hub
info.description: Local-first, scope-filtered text memory for DSH and the QQ bridge.

get.summary: Tools, limits, and feature flags (images/documents/semantic/offline are false in v1).
JSON Schema for the DSH settings page (renderer only, not the config source of truth).
Read the editable runtime config (root token only; settings page backfill).

post.summary: Update whitelisted runtime config (shortTerm / privacy.autoClassify); root token only.

get.summary: List token metadata (root only; hashes are never returned).

post.summary: Revoke one token by id (root only). Issuing stays in the admin CLI.
Identity, audience face, and recent titles for session start.
Keyword search over visible chunks (default k=5, max 10).
Fetch one chunk by id; 404 when absent or not visible in this scene.
Keyword recall from recent chat messages; returns 2–3 short snippets.
Documents in time order, grouped by month — "what was going on back then" instead of similarity.
Cross-scene disclosure: recent messages of ONE group, for a requester the bridge verified as a member (needs the disclose:group scope).
Append one fact to facts/YYYY-MM.jsonl and index it.
Forget one fact by id (or idempotency key); the JSONL keeps a tombstone.
Store ordinary chat messages as short-term memories with a TTL (forgetting curve).
Short-term memories due for the daily review, for the model to promote or let expire.
Promote short-term memories to long-term, optionally with a distilled note.
Read the audience card for a scene (owner-only in practice).
